location.site_description: TDLR TABS2026017746 places Freebird Data Center Phase 1 / DC01 on County Road 133 in Burlington, Milam County; earlier baseline used nearby Cameron as the city label.

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction; Phase 1 is registered with TDLR as private new construction, OpenAI/SB Energy identify the broader Milam County site as a 1.2 GW Stargate data center, and local outreach identifies DPR construction packages for the Burlington Data Center Project. Energization/operation not verified.
evidence_grade: A-: official state TDLR and Texas Comptroller records plus OpenAI/SB Energy first-party announcements verify location, first-phase scope, schedule, tax-certification entries, and 1.2 GW broader lease/site capacity; local building permit, interconnection, and energization records were not located.

actions.summary: OpenAI announced Milam County, Texas as one of two SoftBank/OpenAI Stargate sites, to be developed in partnership with SB Energy as powered infrastructure for a fast-build data center site.
Texas Comptroller listed Milam County Data Center as a Registered Qualifying Large Data Center Project, with owner MDC Building 1, LLC, occupant Orion DC I, LLC, and operator Milam County DC, LLC.

Cameron Industrial Foundation posted a Burlington Data Center community outreach event encouraging Milam County businesses to work with DPR Construction on project scopes including final clean, glazing, fencing, landscaping, catering, and security.

OpenAI and SB Energy announced OpenAI selected SB Energy to build and operate its previously announced 1.2 GW Milam County data center site; OpenAI signed a 1.2 GW data center lease for the initial buildout.

actions.government_body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.summary: TDLR registered TABS2026017746, Freebird Data Center Phase 1 / DC01, as privately funded new construction at County Road 133 in Burlington, Milam County: 548,950 square feet, four data halls, $470 million estimated cost, start date 2025-10-20, and completion date 2026-10-15.

Texas Comptroller listed Milam County Data Center Phase 2 as a Registered Qualifying Large Data Center Project, with owner MDC Building 2, LLC, occupant Orion DC I, LLC, and operator Milam County DC, LLC.

capacity_notes: OpenAI and SB Energy first-party announcements identify a 1.2 GW Milam County data center lease/site. TDLR phase-specific record does not disclose IT load for Freebird Phase 1; industry trackers split building-level capacity estimates separately and are not used as the primary capacity source.
owner: Milam County Data Center LLC / MDC Building 1, LLC and MDC Building 2, LLC in state records; SB Energy build/operator partner; OpenAI tenant/lease counterparty

contradictions.details: Baseline and several trackers describe the campus as Cameron, while TDLR places Freebird Phase 1 at County Road 133 in Burlington, Milam County. Cameron appears to be the nearby county-seat/business-outreach context, not the TDLR site city.
contradictions.resolution: Use Burlington/County Road 133 as the verified site location and keep Cameron as an alias.

contradictions.details: TDLR's current status is 'Project Registered' under the Architectural Barriers program, while OpenAI/SB Energy and local outreach indicate active construction context. No local building permit, certificate of occupancy, interconnection approval, or energization record was found.
contradictions.resolution: Normalize to site work-construction, with energization/operation explicitly unverified.
